g.title: MarieRank1Convo4 begins.
g.text: MarieRank1Convo4 begins.

g.title: j2971147164
g.text: May I ask what I hope is not an impolite question ? It is so very early in our friendship, especially to you, who by the tell of it, have known so many years.

g.title: j2888024872
g.text: I've honestly forgotten most of the years I've known.

g.title: j895553345
g.text: Of course, I don't mind. Go ahead.

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3460308369
g.text: Sol ! You break my heart with your words. You and the devil both find your minds devoid of knowledge like a book with chapters removed, non ?

g.title: j2947588656
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3244955416
g.text: I don't miss the parts of my past I'm lacking.

g.title: j1264037736
g.text: If for very different reasons, yes.

g.title: j523704316
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed counter

g.title: j1134456534
g.text: Truly ? It seems then you are the only one who does not. Between the child and the devil, it seems all are seeking parts of themselves they have misplaced.

g.title: j3913749697
g.text: Is it too much of me to ask why you find yourself so bereft ? The child and the devil's reasons are known to me, but not yours.

g.title: j1353452016
g.text: Why have you agreed to help the devil in his endeavors ? I hear tell you are responsible for the slaughter of his kin.

g.title: j3985455187
g.text: Do you intend to assist the devil in his endeavors ? I hear tell you are responsible for the slaughter of his kin.

g.title: j523704316->j3985455187
g.text: false

g.title: j2377630059
g.text: I have spent some unknown number of years dying at the hands of... well? Myself. I don't mind not being able to remember each one.

g.title: j165005813
g.text: To summarize, I spent... a great number of years suffering. I guess it's some kind of self-defense mechanism, to forget.

g.title: j1349830732
g.text: That was my other self. I believe in holding blame to individuals, not societies.

g.title: j297201666
g.text: That wasn't me, that was the kid. But I hate the Orokin just as much as the kid does.

g.title: j1294830424
g.text: I wasn't there, the Night of the Naga Drums, when the Tenno turned on the Orokin. That was the kid.

g.title: j2909433712
g.text: Nor do I blame you. If I were subject to that manner of abuse, I would be eager enough to tuck it all away. At the very least, I would not go looking for it.

g.title: j3451785913
g.text: I have no doubt ! If I were subject to that manner of abuse, I expect my soul would do something similar. Hide away all that cannot be mended, and does no good.

g.title: j1511220840
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j1633013018
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j1680562208
g.text: Night of the Naga Drums. Oh, I can see it in my mind. Quelles couleurs magnifiques !

g.title: j4167669577
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3130716068
g.text: Oui, je comprends. So quick we are to burn the building down, when the smell is the fault of the rats within its walls.

g.title: j1409381473
g.text: Je meurs d'envie de savoir pourquoi ! But a conversation for another day. Or else we will be here forever, and Monsieur Loid will become cross with me.

g.title: j3451011257
g.text: I will need to speak to Monsieur Loid for more details. But !

g.title: j1878653617
g.text: Although, this may give me some insight over what I wished to speak with you.

g.title: j757649432
g.text: But that is a conversation for another day, or else we will be here forever, and Monsieur Loid will become cross with me.

g.title: j4192617946
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed counter

g.title: j3617244048
g.text: Pardonnez-moi ! I am not giving you a chance to answer. Why lend aid to the devil, then ?

g.title: j2650707701
g.text: Pardonnez-moi ! I am not giving you a chance to answer. Will you lend aid to the devil, then ?

g.title: j4192617946->j2650707701
g.text: false

g.title: j367566950
g.text: He hasn't done anything to prove he isn't worth helping... yet.

g.title: j3391587249
g.text: I don't think I can be in the business of turning away allies.

g.title: j2531869660
g.text: [Confess interest in Roathe.] There's something compelling about him...

g.title: j3016618876
g.text: He seems like he's doing what he needs to survive. I can't fault him for that.

g.title: j3237433545
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j102913786
g.text: Boolean MarieRoatheSoldier is now true.

g.title: j2408386888
g.text: Boolean DrifterRoathe is now true.

g.title: j2827212580
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j755180939
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1822763184
g.text: Ah, I see. You are simply in the business of collecting soldiers. But that devil would sooner sink a dagger betwixt your ribs than guard your back.

g.title: j4245434808
g.text: Le diable séduit les cœurs les plus forts. He plays the cunning game, but be careful. Make sure he meets your eye and nothing else.

g.title: j449389028
g.text: Seems to me he has survived for longer than anyone should. I think perhaps hell should come reclaim its own, it seems to have wandered off.

g.title: j646483790
g.text: I laud your compassion, it fills my heart with joy. The Luminaries teach us that all can be given aid. All can be forgiven. But... only if they seek it.

g.title: j3397732849
g.text: He is no ally of yours, nor will he ever be. That devil sides only with those who serve his needs.

g.title: j327500276
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2323230013
g.text: Endless toil aiding those who never sweat in the field of their own redemption is the life of a slave left wanting.

g.title: j934975467
g.text: I know more about the Orokin and his situation than you. I don't need your help.

g.title: j1645014751
g.text: I appreciate your warnings. I'll keep them in mind when I'm dealing with him.

g.title: j977009305
g.text: Thank you. But I can handle myself. And, more importantly? I have handled worse than him.

g.title: j707077970
g.text: But I am being unkind... you do not know him. You do not see him for what he is. I simply do not wish for you to be hurt.

g.title: j1972622146
g.text: Boolean MarieRoatheWarning is now true.

g.title: j4229426326
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1084496587
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1233696649
g.text: Pardon. I hardly know you or your capacity for withstanding manipulation. I merely worry, as we have heaped our woes upon you.

g.title: j474001735
g.text: That is all I could ask. Merci, merci, merci. Now, I fear I must go.

g.title: j3339479827
g.text: Oui, vous avez raison. I hardly know you or your capacity for withstanding manipulation. I merely worry, as we have heaped our woes upon you.

g.title: j4121985793
g.text: I shall not overstep again.

g.title: j816779171
g.text: And now, I fear I must go.
